description: This file defines API routes and logic for handling Supabase database webhooks, specifically for task-related events in a FastAPI application. It includes functions to verify request authenticity, parse webhook payloads, and trigger email notifications based on database changes.

classes.name: SupabaseWebhookPayload
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the payload structure for Supabase database webhooks, capturing event details such as type, table, schema, and change records.

methods.name: bool _constant_time_equals(a: str, b: str)
methods.description: Performs a constant-time comparison of two strings to prevent timing attacks.

methods.name: None _verify_supabase_hook_secret(request: Request)
methods.description: Middleware to verify incoming webhook requests contain the correct shared secret.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _extract_task_fields(record: dict[str, Any] | None)
methods.description: Extracts common task-related fields from a webhook record, supporting multiple variant column names.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] supabase_tasks_webhook( payload: SupabaseWebhookPayload, request: Request, _auth: None = Depends(_verify_supabase_hook_secret), )
methods.description: Main route handler for processing Supabase webhook events for the 'tasks' table and triggering corresponding email notifications.

methods.name: bool _records_differ(old: dict[str, Any] | None, new: dict[str, Any] | None, key: str)

ctags.name: _records_differ
ctags.pattern: /^def _records_differ(old: dict[str, Any] | None, new: dict[str, Any] | None, key: str) -> bool:$/
ctags.signature: (old: dict[str, Any] | None, new: dict[str, Any] | None, key: str)

ctags.name: supabase_tasks_webhook
ctags.signature: ( payload: SupabaseWebhookPayload, request: Request, _auth: None = Depends(_verify_supabase_hook_secret), )

ctags.name: table
ctags.pattern: /^    table: str = Field(..., description="Table name that triggered the event.")$/

ctags.name: type
ctags.pattern: /^    type: str = Field(..., description="Event type, e.g. INSERT\/UPDATE\/DELETE.")$/
